message:
My neighbour, Nkiru Okafor, checked on me after my walk. Since Tuesday I have had a dry cough at night, but no fever. I think the wheezing started before I changed the air filter, although I am not certain. I would like to describe the timing accurately without assuming a cause.

My separate note about the flat says that the rent is 815 euros each month.
